NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 10th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ i it is informed to all learned members of the Bar

ii) Single Bench of all Hon’ble Judges (including Hon’ble the Chief Justice) wiI
sit at 10:30 a.m. on llth August, 2026.
By Order etc.
